question: what is this company worth, and what does the price already assume?

value_range.reading: Python did not compute a value range, so this reading states none. Under valuation.missing the calculator prints: "WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". Under cost_of_capital.missing it prints: "the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". With no price there is no beta, no market value of equity, no cost of equity and no weights of debt and equity, so there is no discount rate, and none of the bear, base and bull scenarios has an enterprise value, an equity value or a value per share. The inputs that were computed are the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, the equity risk premium of {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt} and {terms.shares_outstanding} shares outstanding. These would carry a value from the firm to a share, but they cannot discount the cash flows that would produce that value. The pre-tax cost of debt of {cost_of_capital.pre_tax_cost_of_debt|pct} is the calculator's fallback of the risk-free rate plus a fixed spread, because no interest expense for the first half of fiscal 2026 is on record. The MD&A states "an approximate weighted-average interest rate" on the long-term notes, and my first pass did not supply it as an override. That override would not have produced a value, because the missing piece is the cost of equity. The drivers in assumptions.json stay as written but are not priced, and no value is estimated here in place of the one Python could not compute.

price_position.reading: Where the price sits in the range cannot be read, because there is no range and there is no price. The calculator holds neither market.price nor cost_of_capital.price_at_cutoff. Under market.missing it prints: "no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched". The free-cash-flow yield, the cross-check that would set trailing free cash flow against the price, is missing for the same reason. What the record does hold is the cash a price would be set against: simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} over the trailing four quarters, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.free_cash_flow_simple} in fiscal 2025. Free cash flow to the firm is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}, which the financial analysis reads as flattered by the low tax field and by cash released from working capital. No position, premium or discount is stated.

market_implied_growth.reading: The reverse DCF was not run. Under implied_growth_beside_history the calculator prints "no reverse DCF: WACC is not computed", so the growth the price assumes is not known and is not estimated here. What can be read is the record that growth would have been compared with, and where my drivers sit on it. Revenue changed by {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} over the trailing four quarters and by {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue_growth|pct} in fiscal 2025, while the quarter grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on the year-ago quarter. The three-year compound is {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, lifted by fiscal 2024's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.revenue_growth|pct}, and the five-year compound is {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}. The company's guidance points up: the release says "we are raising our full-year outlook and now expect sales of about $23 billion", a level above fiscal 2025 revenue of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue} and trailing revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}. It rests partly on orders, which the release defines as commitments that "may not be subject to penalty if cancelled". My base case puts year-one growth above the trailing change and fiscal 2025, close to the five-year compound and below the three-year compound. It does not take the full raised outlook as year one, because the Riello and Noresco businesses leave reported revenue and orders can be cancelled. Growth then fades to a terminal rate below the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}. The bear case starts with a decline milder than the trailing change, and the bull case starts at about the three-year compound. Whether the price at the cutoff asks for more or less than any of these cannot be said until a price and a beta are supplied.

most_sensitive.assumption: operating margin, year one to year ten (named from the spread of my drivers; no sensitivity grid was computed)
most_sensitive.reading: No sensitivity grid and no scenario spread were computed, because valuation holds only its missing reason, so how far value moves with this driver is not measured. I name it because it is where my three scenarios differ most and where the company's record is widest. The trailing operating margin is {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}, the lowest in the record. Fiscal 2025 was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}, the three-year average is {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}, and fiscal 2022 reached {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_margin|pct}. The bear case ends the decade below every fiscal year in the record. The base case ends above the three-year average and below fiscal 2021's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_margin|pct}. The bull case ends above fiscal 2021 but below fiscal 2020 and fiscal 2022. In any run, after-tax operating income would also carry the tax field of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, which a one-time valuation-allowance release holds down. Any reading of how margin moves value would therefore pass through a tax rate that flatters it.

most_sensitive.assumption: revenue growth in year one (named from the spread of my drivers; no sensitivity grid was computed)
most_sensitive.reading: This one is also named from the spread of my drivers, not read off a grid, because no grid was computed. The scenarios run from a decline in the bear case to about the three-year compound of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} in the bull case, and the evidence points both ways. The quarter grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}, and contract liabilities rose to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}, which fits a backlog running ahead of revenue. Against that, trailing revenue changed by {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, and the Riello and Noresco businesses are leaving reported revenue. The model fades year-one growth in a straight line to the terminal rate, so this driver shapes the whole ten-year revenue path. How much it weighs against terminal growth depends on the gap between the discount rate and the terminal rate, and that gap cannot be read while WACC is missing.

accounting_adjustments.reading: There were no accounting adjustments, and with no valuation there was nothing for them to move. The accounting analysis wrote no adjustment, because none of the amounts it describes is a calculator field. The calculator's quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} lists no adjustment applied and none refused, and deducts only share-based pay and acquisitions. Several items the analysis describes would bear on a DCF once one is run. The tax field of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} is held down by a one-time valuation-allowance release, and it would raise after-tax operating income in every scenario. Free cash flow to the firm of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm} counts the change in trade working capital, {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital}, as cash released, and that release need not repeat. The trailing operating cash total also includes discontinued operations. Debt rows inside liabilities held for sale sit outside total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt}. As a result, net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt}, the step from enterprise value to equity value, may understate what the group owes until the disposals settle. None of these is sized here.

summary_ko.value_range: 주가 자료가 주어지지 않아 베타, 자기자본비용, 가중평균자본비용(WACC)을 계산하지 못했고, 그래서 세 시나리오 모두 기업가치와 주당 가치가 나오지 않았습니다. 무위험이자율 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}과 순차입금 {ratios.solvency.net_debt} 같은 다른 입력은 있지만, 계산되지 않은 가치를 대신 추정하지는 않았습니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 기준일 주가가 계산기에 없고 가치 범위도 없어서, 주가가 범위의 어디에 있는지 읽을 수 없습니다. 주가와 비교했을 최근 네 분기 단순 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}입니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역DCF가 계산되지 않아 주가에 담긴 성장률은 알 수 없습니다. 비교할 회사 기록은 최근 네 분기 매출 변화율 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, 삼 년 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, 오 년 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}이며, 회사가 연간 매출 전망을 올렸지만 기본 시나리오의 첫해 성장률은 오 년 연평균 근처에 두었습니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않아 가치가 어느 가정에 가장 민감한지는 측정하지 못했습니다. 세 시나리오가 가장 크게 갈리는 가정은 영업이익률 경로(최근 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}, 삼 년 평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct})와 첫해 매출 성장률입니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 회계 분석은 해당 금액이 계산기 항목에 없어 조정을 하나도 적용하지 않았고, 가치 계산 자체가 없어 조정으로 바뀐 가치도 없습니다. 다만 일회성 세금 혜택으로 낮아진 세율 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}과, 총차입금 {ratios.solvency.total_debt}에 빠진 매각예정 부채 속 차입금은 나중에 가치를 계산할 때 결과를 부풀릴 수 있습니다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
